title: readcell
summary: Read tabular data into a cell array.

gpu_support.notes: File import runs on the host.

description: `readcell(filename, ...)` imports text or spreadsheet data directly into a cell array without consuming detected table headers.
behaviors: Text and spreadsheet options accepted by `readtable` are reused where they apply.
Rows are padded to a rectangular cell array.
Delimited text cells are converted to numeric or logical scalars when they parse cleanly; otherwise they remain strings.
